audit.whatIsWrong: 'early' gave Miasma 'roughly 8 seconds [of grounding] with a 14-second base cooldown'. Miasma is 24/22/20/18/16s. The whole 'there is a gap' argument was built on a cooldown ten seconds too short.
audit.why: A player timing their one E window off a 14s clock steps up while the real ability is still live.
audit.corrected: 24s at rank 1 written into early, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and report[5].t; Twin Fang's 0.75s cadence named in early and whys[1].

audit.whatIsWrong: The page's central claim about Miasma was the grounding — 'you literally cannot dash or use movement tools inside it', 'ground your dashes'. Swain has no dash or movement ability in his kit, so the grounding costs him nothing; the slow is what actually traps him in the poison. 'late' already said this correctly, so the page contradicted itself. Also, wants.foe[1] called Noxious Blast 'your' poison — it is hers.
audit.why: Riot's text: W 'slowing, grounding, and lightly damaging enemies'; Swain's kit contains no Movement ability for the grounding to disable.
audit.corrected: whys[1], early, wants.foe[0], wants.foe[1], dosFull[0].d, breakdown.cooldowns and report[5].t reframed onto the slow, with the ownership of Noxious Blast fixed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Twin Fang heals her for a percentage of the damage dealt and anti-heal is mentioned nowhere on this page — not even in the itemisation block, which lists only Liandry's, Rylai's, Riftmaker and Mercury's Treads.
audit.why: Her sustain is the whole reason the attrition war she wins from level 2 to first item goes her way.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[0].d now names Twin Fang's healing and Grievous Wounds timing.

edits.before: At level 1 this is genuinely even — she has Q poke, you have Q harass at range, and neither of you has a kill threat yet. The moment she hits level 2 and Miasma appears, the entire dynamic shifts: she drops it at her feet to ground you and spam Twin Fang stacks while you literally cannot dash or use movement tools inside it. Play the minion wave on your side so you can farm safely, respect Miasma completely at level 2, and fish for a single E root only when you see Miasma on cooldown — her grounding window is roughly 8 seconds with a 14-second base cooldown, so there is a gap. Do not waste E on a rooted Cass inside Miasma: she will Twin Fang you to death while rooted and still grounded.
edits.after: At level 1 this is genuinely even — she has Q poke, you have Q harass at range, and neither of you has a kill threat yet. The moment she hits level 2 and Miasma appears the dynamic shifts: she drops it at her feet and the slow pins you in the poison while Twin Fang fires every 0.75 seconds. The grounding costs you nothing — you have no dash to lose — so the real price is that you cannot walk out of Noxious Blast. Play the wave on your side, respect Miasma, and fish for a single E only once it is spent: at 24 seconds on rank 1 that gap is long. Do not spend E on a Cass standing in her own Miasma.
